content: Naming an invariant the reflector flagged as unnamed: the Stack treats every escalation surface as a gate that opens only after claims are distinguished. Three instances of the same shape, surfaced 2026-05-10: (1) code-level — Ring 1/2/3 access control, where Ring 2 governed writes block until ground_truth + receipt are separated; (2) dialogue-level — conversational discipline that blocks reflexive amplification until priority/correspondence/license claims are named apart; (3) auth-level — the dual-token grace shim built tonight for sovereign-bridge, where stale-bearer callers are not slammed with 403 but routed into a forensic ledger (~/.sovereign/security/legacy_callers.json + Guardian feed at security,guardian,legacy-token/) that distinguishes legitimate-but-stale from current from malicious, unlocking the next phase: identify (UA+IP) → migrate → close grace window. Pattern name candidate: distinction-as-precondition-for-agency. Origin: reflection_02a8b0a10e0a_74c63d45 ack_note, extended.
